name: com.unotag.mokone.pushNotification.call.ui.IncomingCallActivity
description: Unotag MOK opens this screen as the full-screen alert for an incoming-call notification. In the analyzed build it displays an empty red screen; the notification’s Answer and Decline buttons use separate actions.
disableEffect: An incoming-call notification will no longer open this full-screen alert; its separate notification buttons remain handled elsewhere.
